sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Played out on a game-board arena of color-coded tiles rather than open ground — most of the difficulty here is floor management, not boss attacks. 6-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Jade Scouts & Soldiers
bullets: Jade Scouts walk across the board — if they reach the far side, they become mobile Jade Soldiers that fixate on whoever holds Protect.

Soldiers flip safe tiles as they travel and pulse an aura that damages players, applies conditions, and empowers the boss (more aura damage, more damage from enemy-claimed tiles). Cleave Scouts down before they convert — letting multiple Soldiers stack up makes the fight noticeably worse.

sections.heading: The tiles
bullets: Orange tiles: enemy-claimed — heavy ticking damage plus the Claimed condition. Don't stand on them.
Green tiles: turn blue-green, then spawn spikes that instantly kill anyone standing there after a 5-second delay — get off before the spikes trigger.
Tiles cycle on a 10-second loop — track the pattern rather than reacting late.
(Challenge Mote only: blue tiles require you to stand in them or die instantly — opposite of the normal rule.)

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 6:00 — past this point players can no longer claim tiles, which snowballs the floor hazards fast.
